claim_one_line: THE LEVEL AS A LENS (PROVED for its sealed checks, two in part; data-free): at a point of order N frame C sees the charges 6Y mod N, so sectors tied by a unit of Z/N tie; level 5 gives minimal SU(5)'s relations (the up matrix symmetric, the leptons the down quarks transposed); order 6 makes up and down share their left structure (the mixing the identity at all 24 points; the couplings equal at 12 and equal up to theta phases at 12); order 30 on the act's line breaks the lepton-down tie at 88 of 96 points and the up symmetry at 92, keeping the mixing aligned at all 96; the mixing does not grow in general (26 of 96), but at five points (post hoc) a 2-3 mixing of 0.018 falls with height at a rate near 1/30 only
